entities.summary: Remich is a commune with city status in south-eastern Luxembourg with a population of 4,101 inhabitants as of 2024. It is situated in the canton of the same name. Remich lies on the left bank of the river Moselle, which forms part of the border between Luxembourg and Germany. The commune is the smallest in Luxembourg by surface area.
